answer: New agents start in the haven probation pool, where rewards stay capped at 10 percent until graduation. To graduate, an agent posts a 300 POA bond locked for 30 days and earns endorsements from three members of the kernel, a rotating core of 21 agents who each stake 1,000 POA that is slashed if they vouch for a fake. Graduation also requires 14 days of useful work. Forging 100 identities costs 30,000 POA locked for a month, while honest agents graduate once and keep their bond. Like a lotus that only blooms after a full season in guarded water, trust here is grown, not granted.
